title: ERC-4626 Vault Share Math
description: Recomputes ERC-4626 tokenized-vault share and asset conversions from caller-declared vault state, applying the rounding direction the standard mandates for each function and reporting which direction produced each result alongside what the opposite direction would have produced. ERC-4626 fixes those directions per function: convertToShares and convertToAssets round down towards 0, previewDeposit and previewRedeem round down, previewMint and previewWithdraw round up. Also computes a deposit-then-redeem round-trip loss bound against the post-deposit state, a signed exchange-rate drift between two declared snapshots, and a declared fee application. All arithmetic is exact uint256 integer math with no floating point. Never reads any chain: it cannot know whether the declared totals match a deployed vault, whether that vault applies these directions, or whether a rate change came from yield, loss, a donation, or an attack.

total_assets.description: Vault totalAssets as a non-negative uint256, decimal or 0x-hex string (never a JS number, to avoid precision loss above 2^53).

total_supply.description: Vault totalSupply of shares as a non-negative uint256, decimal or 0x-hex string.

virtual_amounts.description: true (default) uses the OpenZeppelin virtual shares/assets mitigation: shares = assets * (totalSupply + 10**decimals_offset) / (totalAssets + 1). false uses the naive formula, which is the shape a first-depositor inflation attack drains.

decimals_offset.description: Virtual-shares decimals offset, integer 0..36 (default 0). Only meaningful when virtual_amounts is true; a larger offset bounds the inflation-attack loss more tightly.

operations.description: Conversions to recompute. Each entry is {op, amount}, where op is one of convertToShares, convertToAssets, previewDeposit, previewMint, previewWithdraw, previewRedeem. The rounding direction is not selectable: it is fixed per op by ERC-4626 and reported in the result.

round_trip_assets.description: Optional. Deposit this many assets then immediately redeem the shares minted, evaluated against the post-deposit state, to produce a round-trip loss bound in assets and basis points.

snapshot_b.description: Optional. A second {total_assets, total_supply} snapshot; the result carries the scaled share price of each and the signed drift in basis points between them.

fee_bps.description: Optional. Declared fee in basis points, integer 0..10000. ERC-4626 mandates no fee formula; this applies the OpenZeppelin ERC4626Fees shapes, rounding up.

fee_basis.description: 'raw' (fee charged on top of the amount) or 'total' (fee carved out of the amount). Default 'raw'.

chain_id.description: Optional free-text label carried through to the receipt for the reader's own record-keeping. Never a selector: no branch in this tool reads it and no result depends on it.

network_label.description: Optional free-text network label, carried through verbatim. Never a selector.

mcp_tool_definition.name: recompute_erc4626_vault_share_math
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes ERC-4626 vault share/asset conversions from declared vault state under the rounding directions the standard mandates per function, plus a deposit-then-redeem round-trip loss bound, exchange-rate drift between two snapshots, and a declared fee application.

source: authored by ETHMATH-VAULT-1 per ETHMATH-WAVE-BUILD-SPEC.md section 1; the six rounding directions are ERC-4626's own normative text (Final, Created 2021-12-22, CC0-1.0), retrieved and quoted at build time on 2026-08-11; output_schema derived by running the kernel's own compute() directly against the vectors in chaingraph/kernels/fixtures/art-610-erc4626-vault-share-math.fixtures.json; category reuses the existing x402-acp-eudi-wallet-and-basel-3-1-reporting taxonomy value, the same one its sibling declared-input EVM-standard kernels use.
author: PostOakLabs

conversions.eip_rule: MUST return as close to and no more than the exact amount of Vault shares that would be minted in a deposit call
MUST return as close to and no fewer than the exact amount of assets that would be deposited in a mint call
MUST return as close to and no fewer than the exact amount of Vault shares that would be burned in a withdraw call
MUST return as close to and no more than the exact amount of assets that would be withdrawn in a redeem call

rounding_table.eip_rule: MUST return as close to and no more than the exact amount of Vault shares that would be minted in a deposit call
MUST return as close to and no fewer than the exact amount of assets that would be deposited in a mint call
MUST return as close to and no more than the exact amount of assets that would be withdrawn in a redeem call
MUST return as close to and no fewer than the exact amount of Vault shares that would be burned in a withdraw call

output_example.note: Recomputes ERC-4626 share/asset conversions from caller-declared vault state, applying the per-function rounding directions ERC-4626 mandates (convertToShares/convertToAssets/previewDeposit/previewRedeem round down; previewMint/previewWithdraw round up) and reporting the direction used for each. This kernel does NOT read any chain: it cannot know whether the declared total_assets/total_supply match any deployed vault, whether that vault's own implementation actually applies these directions, whether a rate change between two declared snapshots came from yield, loss, donation or an attack, or whether the declared fee basis points are the fee a vault really charges. Round-trip loss and zero-share-mint findings are properties of the declared numbers under the standard's arithmetic, not an audit of any deployment.
